lesson_title: Three Ways to Write the Same Number
hook_text: 3/8, 0,375 and 37,5% walk into a classroom. They are the same number.
clip_script: So three eighths, 0,375 and 37,5 percent are three names for one number. Three eighths: eight goes into one thousand 125 times, so multiply top and bottom by 125: 375 thousandths, 0,375. Decimal to percentage: multiply by one hundred. 0,375 times one hundred is 37,5, so 37,5 percent.
visual_style: A pizza with three of eight slices highlighted, re-sliced into 1 000 tiny pieces with 375 highlighted, then into 100 pieces with 37,5 highlighted.
pacing: Three reveals, one per form, then all three side by side.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson to switch between fractions, decimals and percentages in any direction.
